text:
Noah: Deploy-bot blocked promo for release window. CI verify failed during artifact validation: remote-cache checksum mismatch. This is holding the canary. Need quick call: pin to previous canary or force a cache-busted rebuild? Logs below.

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/web@sha256:ba7e5
expected checksum: sha256:ba7e5
observed in runner-cache-07: sha256:badc0de
action: promotion blocked; awaiting manual decision

Rashida: Runner logs show the cache returned a stale blob header. We saw a purge job yesterday but runner-cache-07 might have missed it.

Ben: If we force rebuild, runners will fetch from cache again during upload which could reintroduce the stale blob. We could run a rebuild with cache-bust and upload to a different temporary tag then re-verify before promote. Time estimate ~18-22m.

Olivia: Change window expires in ~40m. For customer-facing change we should avoid chasing flakiness. I lean toward pinning to last good canary sha256:feedb0b and releasing. Then schedule a clean rebuild + verified upload overnight.

Infra-bot: noticed increased 504s from registry-eu1 at 02:14-02:18 UTC, correlated with multipart upload retries count spike. Filing incident INC-2026-07 for registry-eu1.

Noah: Good catch infra. Two parallel actions: 1) manual promote to previous canary to keep change window, 2) explicit rebuild+upload with --cache-bust and different tag, then re-verify in staging before promoting. Caroline, can you own the manual promote?

Caroline: On it. Command I'll issue: /deploybot promote --image sha256:feedb0b --env canary --meta "pin-checksum-drift"
I'll watch smoke for 15m and abort if error-rate > 0.8%.

Rashida: I'll open the rebuild PR now. Will include an explicit runner step to set CACHE_KEY=none and upload with --atomic to avoid partial parts:
```
ci/build.yml:
  - run: ./ci/build-image --tag=redwood/web:canary-rebuild --cache-bust --upload-flags="--atomic"
```
I'll also add a verification job that downloads from registry-eu1 and checks sha256 before promotion.

Ben: I'll coordinate with infra to trigger a cache purge on runner-cache-07 and add a short TTL bump for 1h to reduce re-stale reads. Infra-bot, can you attach the purge run to the registry incident?

Infra-bot: purge job queued for runner-cache-07, attached to INC-2026-07. Estimated completion in 6m.

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command received from Caroline. Status: queued -> promoting -> smoke-run started.

Noah: Release notes: add a short line: "Canary promotion deferred due to artifact checksum drift; pinned to previous canary sha256:feedb0b while a rebuild and cache purge are performed." Link rebuild PR and incident. Caroline, please add rollback steps in the notes (how to revert to the rebuilt image).

Caroline: Smoke looks clean at +7m. Error-rate 0.2%. Continuing to watch for 8 more minutes.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run passed. Canary promoted to sha256:feedb0b. Promotion complete.

Noah: Thanks. Summary of action items: Caroline promoted + watched, Rashida opened rebuild PR (CI with cache-bust + verify), Ben + Infra to purge runner-cache-07 and monitor registry incident, Olivia will update the product stakeholders and mark the change window used. We'll re-verify the rebuilt image tomorrow and, if clean, promote to stable. Reopen this thread if post-promote metrics spike.
